The Power (P) radiated from an accelerated charged particle is given by $P \propto \frac{(qa)^{m}}{c^{n}}$ where q is the charge, a is the acceleration of the particle and c is speed of light in vacuum. From dimensional analysis, the value of m and n respectively, are
questions.solution:
$\frac{q^{2}}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 rT} = \frac{1}{\varepsilon_0}\frac{q^{m}a^{m}}{c^{n}}$ {taking $\frac{1}{\varepsilon_0}$ in multiplication as constant of proportionality}
$\frac{q^{2}}{rT} = \frac{q^{m}a^{m}}{c^{n}}$
$m = 2$
$\frac{a^{m}}{c^{n}} = \frac{1}{CT^{2}} = \frac{1}{c}\frac{a^{2}}{c^{2}}$   $[c = aT]$
$\frac{a^{m}}{c^{n}} = \frac{a^{2}}{c^{3}}$
$n = 3$

Which of the following quantity has the dimension of length?
(h is Planck’s constant, m is the mass of electron and c is the velocity of light)
questions.solution:
$[h] = [ML^{2}T^{-1}]$
$[c] = [LT^{-1}]$
$[m] = [M^{1}L^{0}T^{0}]$
Dimension of length
$[L] = h^{x}c^{y}m^{z}$
$[L^{1}] = [ML^{2}T^{-1}]^{x}[LT^{-1}]^{y}[M^{1}L^{0}T^{0}]^{z}$
Dimensional analysis on mass
$0 = x + z \Rightarrow x = -z \Rightarrow z = -1$
Dimensional analysis on length
$1 = 2x + y \Rightarrow 2x - x = 1 \Rightarrow x = 1$
Dimensional analysis on time
$0 = -x - y \Rightarrow -x = +y \Rightarrow y = -1$
Therefore final formula is $\frac{h}{mc}$

A body floats with $\frac{1}{n}$ of its volume keeping outside of water. If the body has been taken to height h inside water and released, it will come to the surface after time t. Then
questions.solution:
$F_B = mg$ ; $V\left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right)\sigma g = Vdg$, $\Rightarrow d = \left(\frac{n-1}{n}\right)\sigma$
$a = \frac{F_b - mg}{m} = \frac{v\sigma g}{m} - g$, $a = \frac{v\sigma g}{v\left(\frac{n-1}{n}\right)\sigma} - g$, $\Rightarrow a = \frac{ng}{n-1} - g$, $\Rightarrow a = \frac{g}{n-1}$
Now for time, $h = \frac{1}{2}at^{2}$, $h = \frac{1}{2}\frac{g}{(n-1)}t^{2}$, $\Rightarrow t = \sqrt{\frac{2h}{g}(n-1)}$ $\Rightarrow t \propto \sqrt{n-1}$

When a liquid is poured in the tank to a depth of 40 cm, the distance of the image of the mark above the lens is 48 cm. The refractive index of the liquid is
questions.solution:
Initially without water, $\frac{1}{36} - \frac{1}{-45} = \frac{1}{f} \Rightarrow f = 20$
then, after pouring water upto 40 cm

questions.stem: The electric field of a plane electromagnetic wave in a medium is given by $\vec{E}(x, y, z, t) = E_0\hat{n}e^{ik_0[(x+y+z)-ct]}$ where c is the speed of light in free space. $\vec{E}$ field is polarized in the x – z plane. The speed of wave is $\nu$ in the medium. Then
questions.solution:
$\vec{E} = E_0\hat{n}\,e^{ik_0(\hat{k} \cdot \vec{r} - wt)}$
$\Rightarrow \vec{k} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}$
$\Rightarrow v = \frac{c}{|\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}|} = \frac{c}{\sqrt{3}}$
$\Rightarrow$ refractive index $= \sqrt{3}$
$\vec{E}$ is in z – x plane and $\vec{E} \cdot \vec{V} = 0$
$\Rightarrow \hat{n} = \frac{\hat{i} - \hat{k}}{\sqrt{2}}$

options.text: refractive index of the medium is $\sqrt{3}$
